# Enclave Compute

> Practical AI workflow consulting for Triangle small businesses, with cloud, automation, and private deployment options matched to the work.

## About

Enclave Compute is a Garner-based AI enablement consultancy serving the Research Triangle. We help small businesses choose, build, and adopt one useful AI workflow at a time. We are vendor-pragmatic: managed cloud tools for ordinary work, connected automation for repeatable processes, and private execution when sensitive data or offline operation requires it.

We run a fixed-fee AI Readiness Assessment that maps a workflow, its data boundaries, human review points, success measure, and recommended deployment path. A bounded first workflow can often be targeted for launch within two weeks after requirements, access, and approvals are ready.

## Key facts

- Backed by product and engineering experience spanning payments, enterprise security, confidential computing, healthcare data platforms, cloud systems, and applied AI
- Service area: Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill, Cary, Garner, and the wider Research Triangle, NC
- Deployment options: ChatGPT Business and other managed tools, connected workflow automation, or an on-premise appliance with open-source models
- Selected private workflows can continue through an internet outage
- PII Guard can redact configured identifier types before approved external calls; it reduces exposure but is not a compliance guarantee
- Current proof-of-work is a tested prototype kit using synthetic inputs, not a claim of completed client deployments

## Who we work with

- Healthcare: dental, orthodontic, and medical practices
- Legal: solo practitioners and small firms
- Professional services: accounting, consulting, financial advisory

## Core services

- Workflow Discovery & Training — select a measurable first use case and teach staff to own it
- Cloud AI Adoption — configure managed business AI for ordinary work
- Automation & Integrations — connect approved inputs and systems with human review
- Private AI Deployment — local execution for selected sensitive or offline workflows
